text:
You need a developer who can build a complete matrimonial and social networking platform across Android, iOS, and web, with rich community features, search, messaging, subscriptions, payments, and premium/free experiences all working together smoothly.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to help you shape this into a clean, scalable product experience. With 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I’m especially strong when it comes to organizing complex user flows, structuring information clearly, and making sure product data is easy to understand and act on. For a platform like yours, that matters a lot—because features like profile statistics, compatibility ratings, verification scores, connection requests, boosts, gifts, subscriptions, and payment flows all need to be presented in a way that feels intuitive and trustworthy.

Your concept combines several demanding pieces: social feed behavior, advanced search, chat, profile dashboards, networking tools, subscription management, store purchases, e-wallet integration, settings, and payment processing. I can support the planning and build-out of the data-heavy parts of the product so the user experience stays organized and consistent across the website and mobile apps. I’m also comfortable working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, which helps when product requirements involve tracking, reporting, segmentation, or designing dashboard-style views.

What stands out to me is the need for a platform that serves both free and premium users without making the experience feel fragmented. That means careful attention to access rules, visibility of promoted profiles and ads, and clear presentation of account status and monetization features. I’d approach this with a focus on clarity, reliability, and user-friendly structure.

If helpful, I can work with you on defining the data flow and interface logic for the major modules so the app is easier to build and scale. What part of the platform is the highest priority for you right now: the user profile/dashboard system, the messaging and networking features, or the subscription and payment flow?
